title: Payment on Collection, Insured Shipping and Appraisal Updates
content:
# Counter Card: Payment on Collection, Insured Shipping and Appraisal Updates

**Payment.** Payment on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service is taken at the counter when the piece is collected, or earlier as a deposit where the level requires one, and the balance on the order is what is charged less what has been paid or taken off: each payment taken reduces the balance standing on the order by the amount paid.

**When a payment may be taken.** A payment is taken against a work order only while that order stands in the workshop, ready for pickup, returned unrepaired or already delivered. The state is read from the work order record, correlated by its work order reference, before the payment or the postage line is taken.

**Insured shipping.** The condition that insured shipping is charged per leg at the level's rate is **no longer in force**; what a leg comes to is settled on the current basis for sending a piece back to its owner insured. The declared value shipped never exceeds the level's shipping insurance ceiling, and where the piece is shipped at a declared value above the ceiling the desk does not ship it and the customer collects in person instead.

**Appraisal updates.** An updated appraisal is prepared with the finished work at the levels that include it, and where it is not included it is charged by the appraisal desk on its own terms. The work at the levels that carry it out at the chain's own bench, and at the level whose work is sent to a partner workshop, is charged the same way.

## Quick table

| The work order stands at | A payment or a postage line may be taken |
|---|---|
| in workshop | yes |
| ready for pickup | yes |
| returned unrepaired | yes |
| delivered | yes |
| intake | no |
| estimated | no |
| awaiting authorization | no |
| cancelled | no |
| abandoned | no |

## A worked balance on hypothetical inputs

A work order standing at 480.00 USD owed takes a payment of 200.00 USD at the counter; the balance on the order falls to 280.00 USD. A second payment of 280.00 USD leaves nothing standing on it.
